errors.text: Misidentifies the targeted property as saturation magnetization rather than coercivity.
Substitutes FeCoNiCr and FeCoNiCrMn alloys for the FeCoNiTi dual-phase fcc/C14 system.
Omits the central intervention and structural mediator: rapid-quench stabilization of coexisting fcc and C14 Laves phases.
Replaces the target mechanism—orbital-moment-assisted coercivity and domain-wall pinning in the dual-phase microstructure—with an unsupported claim about DFT overestimating saturation magnetization.
Does not reconstruct the key outcome of approximately 667 Oe coercivity at 400 K, exceeding the roughly 100 Oe single-phase limit.
Cited evidence does not establish the asserted 10–30% saturation-magnetization overestimate or the claimed direction of the orbital-moment correction.
